primary.why_this_state: last commit at which every scientific artifact this release depends on was frozen and independently verified. All code, results and provenance records 01-14 are byte-identical at this tag and at the research repository's later manuscript-only HEAD; everything committed afterwards is manuscript, figure and reviewer-response work and is not released.

kitti_arm.why_separate: The KITTI transfer has its own separately frozen chain, tagged before the tracking arm existed. Its result artifacts are not present at the primary tag, so the three KITTI records released here are taken from this tag instead.

redistribution_summary.note: Only own code, own frozen records and small derived aggregate tables are published. Every corpus and checkpoint is obtained by the reader from its own distributor under its own terms; see docs/DATASETS.md.
